name: firecrawl-playwright
description: Firecrawl Playwright is the browser automation service used by Firecrawl for JavaScript-rendered pages and browser-based scraping. Uses the official Firecrawl Playwright service image. Configuration Port 3000 Internal Playwright service port. Firecrawl connects to Playwright through the firecrawl Docker network. No host port is required. PORT Service listening port. Set to 3000. Storage No persistent storage is required.
